sections.content: Many verbs need a fixed preposition, so you learn the verb together with it. This lesson: *acostumbrarse a* (to get used to), *adaptarse a* (to adapt to), *empezar a* + infinitive (to begin to) and *darse cuenta de* (to realise). The preposition stays the same whatever follows: *a la comida*, *a los horarios*, *a vivir aquí*, *de que ya conocía el barrio*. English often uses a different preposition, so do not translate it: learn each verb with its own.

items.spanish: Poco a poco me adapté a la nueva ciudad.
items.english: Little by little I adapted to the new city.
I got used to the food.

items.spanish: Un día me di cuenta de que ya conocía el barrio.
items.english: One day I realised that I already knew the neighbourhood.

sections.content: Learn the verb with its preposition: *acostumbrarse a*, *adaptarse a*, *empezar a*, *darse cuenta de*.
